svg.text: OPTION B — ECS FARGATE · RDS · S3 · ECR
ECR API / Docker · S3 gateway · CloudWatch Logs · Secrets Manager endpoints
SECURITY: Task Role → S3 · Execution Role → ECR & logs · SG: ALB → ECS → RDS
SINGLE TASK + SINGLE-AZ RDS = NO FULL HIGH AVAILABILITY
